requirements.title: Introduction to WISE
requirements.sourceText: Students will take WSE 101 and WSE 105 in the first year. Receive an “S” (Satisfactory) grade in WSE 101

requirements.title: Course sequence
requirements.sourceText: First Year WSE 101, WSE 105; Second Year WSE 380, WSE 205; Third Year WSE 381, WSE 201; Fourth Year WSE 401, WSE 405. Those entering as sophomores must take WSE 101 and WSE 105 or substitute equivalent courses.

rule.manualCheck: Students who enter after their first semester follow a modified course program.

requirements.title: WSE Practicum
requirements.sourceText: Students are required to participate in a 2-credit practicum experience by enrolling into one of the following courses: (WSE 475/WSE 477/WSE 487/WSE 488). Students must complete the WSE Practicum Permission Request form and maintain departmental approval prior to their enrollment. Courses under a different designator may be considered in lieu of WSE Practicum.

rule.manualCheck: Needs a WSE Practicum Permission Request and departmental approval. A course under another designator may be approved instead.

requirements.title: Senior Thesis or Design Project
requirements.sourceText: Thesis or Design Project WSE 495, WSE 496 ... students must earn a grade of C or higher. These rules apply to students doing their theses or projects under the WSE designator or under a departmental designator. Students must obtain WISE Honors departmental approval for registration under a designator other than WSE.

rule.manualCheck: A project under a departmental designator needs WISE Honors approval. A letter of intent is due before the add/drop deadline; the thesis is presented at the University Honors Programs Senior Symposium.

policies.sourceText: pass all of the courses of the WISE Honors curriculum with a C or higher grade including a Senior Thesis or Design Project

notes.text: WISE courses fulfill GLO (WSE 105 and WSE 201), HUM and DIV (WSE 201), TECH (WSE 380), SBS (WSE 381), STAS (WSE 401), and ESI, EXP+, CER, SPK, and WRTD (WSE 495/496). Students also complete ARTS, QPS, SNW, USA, and WRT, and advanced studies in two of HFA+, SBS+, and STEM+. Students who leave WISE Honors must complete all remaining SBC requirements.

To stay in WISE Honors and receive the transcript notation: enroll in and maintain a STEM major, an S in WSE 101, a C or higher in all WISE courses, and a cumulative GPA of at least 3.0. A WSE course with a grade of C- or lower may be repeated on request.
Transfer students, first-year students, and sophomores not initially in WISE Honors can apply.
